mintAuthority.summary: EURS native issuance is reviewed on Ethereum, Algorand, Stellar, and XDC. Ethereum mint, freeze, and delegate administration is controlled by the STASIS 3-of-7 Safe; verified source resolves storage slot 3 as the fee collector, not a control. Algorand uses a fixed 3-of-5 issuer multisig as the ASA manager/reserve/freeze account, XDC uses a 2-of-5 issuer controller, and Stellar uses a 3-of-5 issuer account. Polygon, Arbitrum, and Gnosis are external representations whose bridge controls are assessed only in Bridge Risk.

upgradeability.controlRef: STASIS owner Safe (native mint, freeze, and delegate authority)

controls.label: STASIS owner Safe (native mint, freeze, and delegate authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770442, EURSToken storage slot 2 still held this delegate Safe. The current Safe API read returned the listed 3-of-7 owners, no enabled modules, a zero guard, and Safe 1.3.0. Current eth_call simulations of createTokens(0), createTokens(1), freezeTransfers(), and unfreezeTransfers() succeeded from this Safe. The verified token source also exposes Safe-gated setDelegate administration, so this Safe can authorize a replacement issuer and replace native mint logic without an on-chain supply ceiling.

controls.label: Algorand EURS ASA manager/reserve/freeze account
controls.capDescription: ASA 227855942 has the uint64 maximum total. The issuer-controlled account is simultaneously manager, reserve, and freeze authority; the manager can change ASA management fields and the reserve account can issue units up to that maximum.
controls.evidence: At Algorand round 64481636 on 2026-08-27, ASA 227855942 still reported STASIS EURO/EURS, six decimals, a maximum uint64 total, and this same issuer account as manager, reserve, and freeze authority; clawback remained the zero address. The current account record had no auth-addr, so it had not been rekeyed. Its outgoing asset-transfer transaction N7TEJ4JBNH2ATKCGYHGNVDLHA4NOPDAYT66QR5ZNAWO6NBCXXDUA carries an Algorand multisig envelope with version 1, threshold 3, and five fixed public keys, three of which signed. The manager/reserve account is therefore a native 3-of-5 issuer control path.

controls.label: XDC EURS issuer MultiSigWallet controller

sources.label: Pinned XDC RPC controller and mint-call reads at block 107888010

controls.evidence: At XDC block 107888010 on 2026-10-01, getOwners() returned five owners and required() returned 2 for this MultiSigWallet-style controller. An eth_call of createTokens(1) on the native EURS token returned true with this controller as msg.sender. The 2-of-5 native mint path remains executable, so its selection as the weakest native authority is based on verified control facts. The historical review recorded rejection from unrelated senders and lacked an exact verified token source match; this refresh corroborates the controller quorum and successful controller-origin call without claiming a new source-code verification.

controls.label: Stellar issuer account multisig
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63986038, the current Horizon read still showed five active weight-one signers, a weight-zero master key, and low/medium/high thresholds of 3. The account's last-modified ledger was 63395662. This 3-of-5 issuer account can create unbounded Stellar EURS trustline balances; no contract supply cap applies.

review.evidence: Historical native-control observations are retained, not renewed: the review covers Ethereum, Algorand, Stellar, and XDC only. At Ethereum block 25770442, Safe 0x1bee4f735062cd00841d6997964f187f5f5f5ac9 was the 3-of-7 owner/delegate authority; createTokens and freeze/unfreeze simulations succeeded from the Safe. Verified EURSToken source places owner at slot 2 and feeCollector at slot 3 and gates createTokens, freezeTransfers and setDelegate on owner. At Algorand round 64481636, ASA 227855942 used the unrekeyed 3-of-5 issuer account as manager, reserve and freeze authority with maximum uint64 total. Stellar ledger 63986038 showed five weight-one signers and 3-of-5 thresholds. The historical XDC 2-of-5 mint-controller proof and its separately dated October 1 observation remain unchanged. Polygon, Arbitrum and Gnosis representations remain Bridge Risk, not native issuance. FD23 source-scope correction on 2026-10-20: the cited transparency page shows 6,942,132 EURS and EUR 7,147,300.66 reserves but gives neither a common economic as-of time nor a complete liabilities-to-reserves reconciliation. The bankCirculation/getAll API likewise supplies undated amounts. The daily statement index ends on 2025-12-12, the verification index on 2024-08-02 and the annual audit index on 2024-05-20. No cited source retrieved in this review supports the former assertion of an assets-and-liabilities statement for 2026-08-07 published on 2026-08-08. A generic daily-publication promise, undated balance display and historical BDO report do not establish a currently performed recurring whole-native-supply reconciliation. Reconciliation is therefore unknown, not measured absent. Known unbounded issuer powers and the original no-verified-prudential-supervision disposition remain; the derived annotation is unbounded-adverse. Original review start and every on-chain pin are preserved.
